Subject: Progressive-year renewal migration + sync window

Hi Daniel / Acme procurement team,

Following our renewal call today, I put together a concise option that converts your single-year renewals into a progressive 3-year ramp that smooths spend while aligning all product contracts to a single sync window (calendar Q1). High-level: 

- Year 1: 70% committed capacity (lower effective unit price) + burst buffer at current rates
- Year 2: 85% committed capacity, automated top-up for sustained usage
- Year 3: 100% committed with annual true-up and optional prepay credit

Key customer-facing benefits: predictable unit economics, clear burst runway, and a single renewal cadence to reduce procurement overhead. We included an explicit opt-out clause for auto-renew during the migration window so you can decline auto-extension in any rollover year with 45 days' notice.

I've attached a short proposal and a mutual action plan workbook showing milestone-driven invoicing and delivery triggers. Can you confirm: 1) whether Acme requires quarterly invoicing or annual invoicing for this structure, and 2) who on procurement should receive the DocuSign envelope when we finalize terms?

Attachments: 2026-10-09_ACME_Progressive_Renewal_Proposal.pdf, mutual-action-plan_ACME-v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
